original_text: We evaluate the noise covariance matrices of pulsars following \cite{2014PhRvD..90j4012V} and using the \textsc{enterprise} Python software \cite{enterprise}.
injected_text: We evaluate the noise covariance matrices of pulsars following the time-frequency wavelet decomposition method of \cite{2014PhRvD..90j4012V} and using the \textsc{enterprise} Python software \cite{enterprise}.
rationale: The cite key 2014PhRvD..90j4012V (van Haasteren & Vallisneri 2014) is preserved verbatim, but the claim now attributes to that paper a 'time-frequency wavelet decomposition method' for pulsar noise covariances. The cited paper is exclusively about a Gaussian-process formulation of pulsar-timing data analysis and does not discuss wavelet methods at all, so a careful reader of the cited PDF returns UNRELATED — realising the C/S3/topic-mis-attribution target.
ground_truth_description: Replaced the methodological description attached to \cite{2014PhRvD..90j4012V} so that the paper is now (incorrectly) credited with a wavelet-based decomposition method for pulsar noise covariances — a topic absent from the cited Gaussian-process paper.

truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: We evaluate the noise covariance matrices of pulsars following the time-frequency wavelet decomposition method of \cite{2014PhRvD..90j4012V} and using the \textsc{enterprise} Python software \cite{enterprise}.
